courses.title: 1:1 Mentorship
courses.description: Single two-hour mentoring sessions with Marta, online or in person, by application, with ongoing mentorship possible afterwards. Each session is built around what the person brings, drawing on Yoga of Emotions, somatic work, meditation, breathwork, journaling and dance.
